description:
A powerful ultra-lightweight floating browser.

One of the core functions of Floweb is to convert any web page into a WebApp, allowing you to start and run web pages just like using local applications. Now you can quickly add the most commonly used websites or services, such as email, social media, online documents, etc., to your desktop for one-click access.
🌟 New: workspace temp tabs (⌘T/⌘W/⌘⇧T, open URLs directly), in-group tab clusters with folding, site/script/workspace preset packages, a 26-check config doctor, per-site zoom memory, recent apps in the tray, search bangs with 20 engines, keychain TOTP autofill, and Playbook run history. Fixes: temp tabs no longer delete same-named sites, cluster edits no longer overwrite concurrent changes, saving a schedule keeps its run history, group-switch shortcuts actually register, and tray/zoom updates refresh promptly — plus import/export, notification and startup edge cases.
